resolution_rule.closure_condition: All selected native Atlas IDs must have either direct active-code linkage or grouped ACABC/ACATQ active-record linkage.
resolution_rule.direct_linkage: Use primary active-code Atlas linked_atlas_record_ids when present.
resolution_rule.grouped_satisfaction_overlay: For native Atlas records without direct active-code ID linkage, use the surface Bridge comparison group and queued implementation leaf whose active-code records explicitly link to the same ACABC/ACATQ records. This resolves traceability at group level without inventing one-to-one links.
